catalog_revision_note: Initial catalog gate added; all component/function readiness remains evidence-gated and no production certification is implied.

authority.role: architecture, ownership, interface, acceptance and evidence registry only
authority.implementation_rule: Canonical implementation remains in each component's source repository.

evidence_policy.rule: PRODUCTION_READY requires exact source SHA, required gate run/job/step, exit code 0, logs or artifacts, acceptance criteria, security review where applicable, and no unresolved critical residual.

production_gates.name: Canonical ownership
acceptance: Exactly one canonical implementation owner per capability
Support/spec repositories are not misrepresented as implementation owners

production_gates.name: Interface contract
acceptance: Inputs, outputs, error semantics, versioning and compatibility policy documented
Cross-repository dependencies point to versioned contracts

production_gates.name: Functional correctness
acceptance: Positive, negative, boundary and regression tests pass at exact source SHA
Deterministic components have reproducible vectors

production_gates.name: Security and failure behavior
acceptance: Threat model and trust boundary documented
Invalid input, privilege failure, resource exhaustion and recovery behavior tested

production_gates.name: Build and supply-chain integrity
acceptance: Required format, lint, build, test and security gates have terminal successful conclusions
Skipped checks are recorded as skipped and do not count as passing

production_gates.name: Operational readiness
acceptance: Diagnostics, versioning, rollback/recovery and compatibility are documented where applicable
Release artifacts are traceable to source SHA

production_gates.name: Evidence completeness
acceptance: Run, job, step, exit code and log/artifact URL are recorded against exact SHA
Independent review closes or accepts each residual

components.name: atc-engineering
components.role: fleet governance, CI policy and engineering assurance

functions.name: Repository policy enforcement
functions.purpose: Apply required repository and branch governance without silently weakening protections.
acceptance: Policy evaluation is deterministic for the same inputs
Missing evidence fails closed
Changes are audited and do not auto-merge

functions.name: Exact-SHA evidence audit
functions.purpose: Bind CI conclusions and artifacts to the precise source commit.
acceptance: Every VERIFIED result references the exact tested SHA
Pending, skipped or inaccessible checks never become green

components.name: ATC Standards
components.role: normative standards, schemas and conformance requirements

functions.name: Normative specification registry
functions.purpose: Publish versioned standards with status, authority, scope and supersession links.
acceptance: IDs are unique and schema-valid
Draft and approved standards are distinguishable
Conflicts are recorded rather than silently resolved

functions.name: Conformance contract
functions.purpose: Define testable requirements and machine-readable pass/fail evidence for implementations.
acceptance: Each mandatory requirement maps to a test or explicit manual review
Conformance binds to exact source SHA and standard version

components.name: ATCLang
components.role: language syntax, parsing and frontend representation

functions.name: Source parsing and diagnostics
functions.purpose: Parse valid source and report invalid syntax with stable, actionable diagnostics.
acceptance: Grammar/version behavior is documented
Malformed input returns a controlled diagnostic without panic
Golden parser and negative tests pass

functions.name: AST and directive validation
functions.purpose: Validate language directives and AST invariants before code generation.
acceptance: Every directive has documented semantics
Invalid AST states are rejected
Equivalent source yields stable normalized output where required

components.name: ShivaCore Kernel
components.role: no_std capability microkernel and trusted computing base

functions.name: Capability authorization
functions.purpose: Enforce explicit authority for process, object and resource access.
acceptance: Default is deny
No ambient authority is introduced
Cross-process and revocation tests demonstrate isolation

functions.name: IPC and process isolation
functions.purpose: Provide bounded message exchange while preserving address-space and capability boundaries.
acceptance: Unauthorized send/receive is rejected
Bounds and ownership are checked
Concurrency, fault and denial-of-service tests pass

functions.name: Virtual-memory mapping lifecycle
functions.purpose: Manage page mapping, rollback, unmapping and object/mapping lifetime safely.
acceptance: Mutations are transactional or rollback-safe
Unmap invalidates leaf before reclaiming empty tables
No use-after-free or stale mapping survives lifecycle tests

components.name: A-TownChain Blockchain Core
components.role: canonical L1 chain, transaction, block and state implementation

functions.name: Transaction validation and signing contract
functions.purpose: Validate transaction encoding, signature policy, domain separation and replay constraints.
acceptance: TX-V2 secp256k1 ECDSA uses RFC6979/SHA-256 and low-S
Public key and signature lengths are enforced
ATC-TX-DOMAIN-V2 is used and legacy domains are rejected
Golden vectors match across supported platforms

functions.name: Canonical amount and state encoding
functions.purpose: Encode protocol amounts and counters without precision loss or platform-dependent behavior.
outputs: canonical byte encoding or typed error
acceptance: Amounts use 16-byte big-endian u128
Counters use 8-byte big-endian u64
Chain ID 658467, supply 360000000 ATC and 18 decimals agree with normative specs
Boundary and round-trip vectors pass

functions.name: Block/state transition validation
functions.purpose: Apply a block only when transaction, ordering, state-transition and protocol invariants hold.
acceptance: Invalid blocks cannot partially mutate canonical state
Transition results are deterministic
Reorg/replay and boundary tests pass

components.name: ATC-Algorithm
components.role: canonical consensus and deterministic selection implementation

functions.name: Consensus transition and validation
functions.purpose: Evaluate candidate blocks and consensus transitions according to a frozen normative protocol.
acceptance: Consensus algorithm and parameters are formally selected and versioned
PoH/PoW/PoS/PoI alternatives are not treated as finalized without decision evidence
Deterministic vectors and adversarial safety/liveness tests pass

functions.name: Validator/participant selection
functions.purpose: Select participants deterministically using canonical encoded inputs and overflow-safe arithmetic.
acceptance: Canonical hash/seed path is specified
u128 stake arithmetic is checked
Cross-platform results match golden vectors
Adversarial distribution tests are reviewed

functions.name: Bytecode decoding and validation
functions.purpose: Decode the normative ATC bytecode format and reject malformed programs before unsafe execution.
outputs: validated instruction stream or typed rejection
acceptance: Normative magic ATCB, u16 BE version and u32 BE instruction count are unambiguous
ATCB versus ATC1 drift is resolved against the normative spec
Malformed and oversized bytecode is rejected

functions.name: Deterministic bounded execution
functions.purpose: Execute programs with explicit gas and resource limits and deterministic state effects.
outputs: result/state delta or typed execution error
acceptance: MAX_PROGRAM_OPS=65536, MAX_STACK_ITEMS=4096 and MAX_STORAGE_SLOTS=65536 are enforced
Gas accounting and overflow behavior are normative
Repeated execution yields identical results for identical inputs

components.name: GlobusOS
components.role: userspace services, hardware integration and OS platform above ShivaCore

functions.name: Service lifecycle and isolation
functions.purpose: Start, supervise, isolate and recover userspace services without expanding kernel authority.
acceptance: Service boundaries remain outside kernel TCB
Restart/recovery behavior is bounded and observable
Unauthorized service access is denied

functions.name: Boot and platform discovery
functions.purpose: Boot the OS and enumerate supported platform resources through explicit HAL boundaries.
acceptance: Reproducible QEMU boot evidence exists
UEFI Secure Boot and ACPI paths are tested on declared targets
Failure logs identify stage and cause

components.name: Aurora AI
components.role: AI runtime, assistant, agent and swarm coordination outside kernel TCB and consensus

functions.name: Intent-to-proposal planning
functions.purpose: Convert user intent into an inspectable proposal without directly exercising privileged authority.
acceptance: Proposals are distinguishable from executed actions
Ambiguity and uncertainty are surfaced
No direct kernel or consensus authority is granted

functions.name: Policy/capability-gated tool invocation
functions.purpose: Require policy evaluation, capability checks and approval before tool execution across a service boundary.
acceptance: Intent → Policy → Capability Check → Approval → Tool → Service Boundary is enforced
Default is deny for missing authorization
All actions have traceable inputs, approvals and outcomes

functions.name: Swarm coordination and result validation
functions.purpose: Coordinate bounded agents and reconcile results without allowing agents to override policy or canonical state.
acceptance: Agent outputs are treated as untrusted until validated
Resource budgets and cancellation are enforced
No agent can bypass policy or alter consensus/kernel authority

functions.name: Compile and package reproducibly
functions.purpose: Transform versioned source inputs into traceable artifacts for declared targets.
acceptance: Build inputs and versions are recorded
Reproducibility is checked for supported targets
Artifacts link to exact source and toolchain SHAs

functions.name: Developer diagnostics and conformance tests
functions.purpose: Run compiler/VM conformance suites and provide stable, actionable diagnostics.
acceptance: Exit status accurately reflects failures
Required negative tests cannot be silently skipped
Reports identify exact versions and source SHA

functions.name: Genesis configuration validation
functions.purpose: Validate genesis inputs and network configuration before generating artifacts or initializing state.
acceptance: Inputs are schema-validated and deterministic
Chain ID/economics agree with the normative protocol
Invalid configuration fails before state mutation

functions.name: Environment bootstrap and compatibility
functions.purpose: Bootstrap a declared environment and verify compatible component versions before activation.
acceptance: Dependencies and versions are explicit
Bootstrap is repeatable and reports partial failure
Privileged actions pass policy/capability checks

components.name: a-townchain-ecosystem
components.role: system-of-systems integration, architecture, compliance and evidence control plane only

functions.name: Cross-repository ownership and dependency registry
functions.purpose: Record canonical ownership, interfaces, dependencies and unresolved architecture conflicts across repositories.
acceptance: Every active repository has an explicit role and audit status
Unknown data remains residual
The control plane contains no competing canonical VM/algorithm/kernel implementation

functions.name: Release evidence aggregation
functions.purpose: Aggregate required gate outcomes and evidence without upgrading incomplete checks to success.
acceptance: Evidence binds to exact SHA and required run/job/step
Skipped checks remain explicitly skipped
No auto-merge and no self-certification

cross_component_interfaces.contract: Versioned source/AST/diagnostic contract; exact API and version must be confirmed from canonical repositories
Normative bytecode format, version, opcode semantics and compiler/VM conformance vectors
Versioned consensus inputs, canonical encoding, transition result and error semantics
Contract execution context, state access, resource/gas accounting and deterministic result contract
Kernel syscall/capability/IPC ABI; versioned and privilege-minimized
Service API with explicit capabilities, policy, approval, quotas and audit events
Versioned normative governance and conformance rules

release_decision.reason: This catalog establishes ownership and measurable function-level acceptance criteria. Component production readiness remains unverified until source-specific implementation, exact-SHA gates, interface conformance and required security/operational evidence are attached.
forbidden_shortcuts: archive or delete source repositories based on catalog alone
